commit.message: K8S-3775: Update helm charts for 2.8.1 release
K8S-3886 update image versions for server and sync gateway

K8S-3144: prepare helm for 2.5 release

- updated github actions
- updated crd.yaml
- deprecated the `couchbaseCluster.spec.securityContext` in favor of
`couchbaseCluster.spec.security.podSecurityContext`
- Added a default for
  `couchbaseClutser.spec.security.securityContext.allowPrivilegeEscalation=false`

K8S-3067: 2.42.1 release

Incremented release version for bugfix release.

updated for 2.4.1 support

updated versions and added annotation support.

K8S-2732: Manually define RBAC resources

In the past Users were created and automatically bound to roles for
convience. This came at the cost of customization now that
scopes/collections along with LDAP allow for much more advanced
configurations.

This change allows users to be set with an 'autobind' property that
can disable the automatic resource creation and manually create
themselves.

K8S-2615: Upgrade TLS model

Support native tls secret types.
Generate rootCA along with separate client/server cert/keys.

Allows backward compatibility for legacy installs during upgrade.
Additional detail and consistency for documented values

Remove unsupported alpha values #71

allocateLoadBalancerNodePort and securityContext...hostProcess
are alpha in 1.20,1.21 and so validation doesn't take it serious,
but in 1.22 the values cannot be set in conjunction with default
helm deployment.  For instance, default networking is NodePort
and allocateLoadBalancerNodePort can only be set with LoadBalancer type.

..also synced CRD
PublishedNotReady and other values removed from CRD

Ensure we have fixes for recent release merged into templates.
Also resolve issue with K8S-2342 setting invalid compaction time periods by default.

Reorganize repo structure

Move's published charts into 'charts' subdirectory
while putting examples elsewhere to make publishing easier.
